secrets.description: Sensitive data that must be encrypted. Set these in: Repository Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → Secrets

required.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
required.reason: API token with full access to JIRA

required.name: CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN
required.reason: API token with full access to Confluence

required.name: CONFLUENCE_UPLOAD_EMAIL
required.description: Confluence user email for uploading results (optional - if different from fetch email)

required.name: CONFLUENCE_UPLOAD_API_TOKEN
required.description: Confluence API token for uploading results (optional - if different from fetch token)
required.reason: API token with full access to Confluence

required.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_BEDROCK
required.description: AWS access key for Bedrock authentication (optional - only required when AI_TYPE=1)

required.name: AWS_SECRET_KEY_BEDROCK
required.description: AWS secret key for Bedrock authentication (optional - only required when AI_TYPE=1)

required.name: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
required.description: Anthropic API base URL (for GLM or custom endpoints) - required when AI_TYPE=2

required.name: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
required.description: Anthropic API authentication token (for GLM) - required when AI_TYPE=2

required.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
required.description: OpenAI API key for embeddings - used by both quality check and test generation workflows (optional - required only if USE_POSTGRES_VECTOR_DB is enabled)
required.reason: OpenAI API credentials for embeddings generation

optional_with_defaults.name: DATABASE_HOST
optional_with_defaults.description: PostgreSQL database host - has default in action.yml, only override if using external database
optional_with_defaults.reason: Database connection configuration - uses Docker container by default

optional_with_defaults.name: DATABASE_PORT
optional_with_defaults.description: PostgreSQL database port - has default in action.yml

optional_with_defaults.name: DATABASE_NAME
optional_with_defaults.description: PostgreSQL database name - has default in action.yml

optional_with_defaults.name: DATABASE_USER
optional_with_defaults.description: PostgreSQL database user - has default in action.yml
optional_with_defaults.reason: Database authentication - uses default for Docker container

optional_with_defaults.name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
optional_with_defaults.description: PostgreSQL database password - has default in action.yml
optional_with_defaults.reason: Database authentication - uses default for Docker container

variables.description: Non-sensitive configuration values. Set these in: Repository Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → Variables

required.name: JIRA_URL
required.reason: Public JIRA instance URL, not sensitive

required.name: CONFLUENCE_URL
required.reason: Public Confluence instance URL, not sensitive

optional.name: CONFLUENCE_UPLOAD_URL
optional.description: Confluence instance URL for uploading results (optional - if different from fetch URL)
optional.reason: Public Confluence instance URL, not sensitive

optional.name: AWS_REGION_BEDROCK
optional.description: AWS region for Bedrock service (optional - only required when AI_TYPE=1)

optional.name: CONFLUENCE_UPLOAD_SPACE_KEY
optional.description: Confluence space key for uploading results (optional - if different from fetch space)

optional.name: UPLOAD_TO_CONFLUENCE
optional.description: Whether to upload results to Confluence (true/false)

optional.name: USE_POSTGRES_VECTOR_DB
optional.description: Enable PostgreSQL Vector Database with pgvector for RAG-based Confluence fetching (true/false)

environment_specific.description: Values that are automatically provided by GitHub Actions context

usage_in_workflow.note: Two types of workflows use different secret prefixes: UT_QUALITY_* for quality check workflow, UT_GENERATE_* for test generation workflow

setup_instructions.important_note: ⚠️ Each secret needs TWO entries with different prefixes: UT_QUALITY_* for quality check workflow and UT_GENERATE_* for test generation workflow. For example, OPENAI_API_KEY needs both UT_QUALITY_OPENAI_API_KEY and UT_GENERATE_OPENAI_API_KEY. JIRA_URL and CONFLUENCE_URL are now VARIABLES, not secrets.

security_best_practices: Never commit secrets or API tokens to the repository
Rotate API tokens regularly (every 90 days recommended)
Use dedicated service accounts for CI/CD workflows
Limit API token permissions to minimum required scope
Use organization-level secrets for shared credentials across repos
Enable secret scanning on your repository
Review and audit secret access logs periodically
JIRA_URL and CONFLUENCE_URL are now public variables (not secrets) - they don't contain sensitive information
